messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: passing policies
parts:
I've been thinking more about error policies.

One thing we can do is treat them as statically
configured in Boost and require resetting a global
default rather than allowing our functions to
be configurable one-by-one.

On the other hand, if they're configurable one-by-one
and I can add variable names in the graphical models
to the policies, that'd be awesome for debugging
complex models.

If we do allow declared policies, we'll need to
pass them through to all the embedded functions.
If we just assume a single master config, we won't need
to bother with this.

- Bob
